segments.title: Only ONE of these is real
segments.say: Only one of these messages is real. Guess which.

segments.text: “Hi Mum, new number. Phone broke. Can you send money today?”
segments.say: One. Hi Mum, new number, can you send money today?

segments.text: “Your OTP is 4821. Never share it with anyone.”
segments.say: Two. Your code is four eight two one. Never share it.

segments.text: “Part-time job! Like videos, earn ₹5,000 a day.”
segments.say: Three. Part time job. Like videos, earn five thousand a day.

segments.title: Answer
bullets: Real: tells you not to share
segments.say: Only two is real. One and three are classic scams.
